agobard-de-grandine-et-tonitruis-latin.title: Liber de grandine et tonitruis
agobard-de-grandine-et-tonitruis-latin.creator: Agobard of Lyons
agobard-de-grandine-et-tonitruis-latin.description: Carolingian archbishop's attack on weather-magic and the tempestarii; the earliest systematic ecclesiastical refutation of popular magic, cited for a millennium.

arxiv-1910-06926.title: Supplemental Material for LHCb-PAPER-2019-031
arxiv-1910-06926.creator: Search for
arxiv-1910-06926.description: Abstract Searches are performed for both prompt-like and long-lived dark photons, A ′ A^{\prime} , produced in proton-proton collisions at a center-of-mass energy of 13 Te ​ V \mathrm{\,Te\kern-1.00006ptV} . These searches look for A ′ → μ + ​ μ − A^{\prime}\!\to\!\mu^{+}\mu^{-} decays using a data sample corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 5.

arxiv-2104-09697.title: Introducing the Partitioned Equivalence Test: Artificial Intelligence in Automatic Passenger Counting Validation
arxiv-2104-09697.creator: David Ellenberger, Michael Siebert
arxiv-2104-09697.description: Abstract Automatic passenger counting (APC) in public transport has been introduced in the 1970s and has been rapidly emerging in recent years. APC systems, like all other measurement devices, are susceptible to error, which is treated as random noise and is required to not exceed certain bounds.

arxiv-2202-07203.title: Collision-free Path Planning in the Latent Space through cGANs
arxiv-2202-07203.creator: Tomoki Ando, Hiroki Mori, Ryota Torishima, Kuniyuki Takahashi, Shoichiro Yamaguchi, Daisuke Okanohara, Tetsuya Ogata
arxiv-2202-07203.description: Abstract We show a new method for collision-free path planning by cGANs by mapping its latent space to only the collision-free areas of the robot joint space. Our method simply provides this collision-free latent space after which any planner, using any optimization conditions, can be used to generate the most suitable paths on the fly.

arxiv-2212-06067.title: Photon-number moments and cumulants of Gaussian states
arxiv-2212-06067.creator: Yanic Cardin, Nicolás Quesada
arxiv-2212-06067.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yanic Cardin, Nicolás Quesada. We develop closed-form expressions for the moments and cumulants of Gaussian states when measured in the photon-number basis. We express the photon-number moments of a Gaussian state in terms of the loop Hafnian, a function that when applied to a ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) -matrix representing the adjacency of a graph, counts the number of its perfect matchings.

arxiv-2212-11041.title: What should clubs monitor to predict future value of football players
arxiv-2212-11041.creator: Ali Baouan, Elsa Bismuth, Aurèle Bohbot, Sebastien Coustou
arxiv-2212-11041.description: Abstract Huge amounts of money are invested every year by football clubs on transfers. For both growth and survival, it is crucial for recruiting departments to make smart choices when targeting players. Therefore, it is very important to identify the right parameters to monitor to predict market value.

arxiv-2306-09042.title: A Graphical Formalism for Commonsense Reasoning with Recipes
arxiv-2306-09042.creator: Antonis Bikakis, Aissatou Diallo, Luke Dickens, Anthony Hunter, Rob Miller
arxiv-2306-09042.description: Abstract Whilst cooking is a very important human activity, there has been little consideration given to how we can formalize recipes for use in a reasoning framework. We address this need by proposing a graphical formalization that captures the comestibles (ingredients, intermediate food items, and final products), and the actions on comestibles in the form of a labelled bipartite graph.

arxiv-2307-16047.title: On Δ \Delta -spaces
arxiv-2307-16047.creator: Arkady Leiderman, Paul Szeptycki
arxiv-2307-16047.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Arkady Leiderman, Paul Szeptycki. Δ \Delta -spaces have been defined by a natural generalization of a classical notion of Δ \Delta -sets of reals to Tychonoff topological spaces; moreover, the class Δ \Delta of all Δ \Delta -spaces consists precisely of those X X for which the locally convex space C p ​ ( X ) C_{p}(X) is distinguished [ 25 ] .

arxiv-2312-17033.title: Boolean TQFTs with accumulating defects, sofic systems, and automata for infinite words
arxiv-2312-17033.creator: Paul Gustafson, Mee Seong Im, Mikhail Khovanov
arxiv-2312-17033.description: Abstract . Any finite state automaton gives rise to a Boolean one-dimensional TQFT with defects and inner endpoints of cobordisms. This paper extends the correspondence to Boolean TQFTs where defects accumulate toward inner endpoints, relating such TQFTs and topological theories to sofic systems and ω \omega -automata.

arxiv-2401-13126.title: Optimizing Transition Strategies for Small to Medium Sized Portfolios
arxiv-2401-13126.creator: Nakul Upadhya, Alexandre Granzer-Guay
arxiv-2401-13126.description: Abstract This work discusses the benefits of constrained portfolio turnover strategies for small to medium-sized portfolios. We propose a dynamic multi-period model that aims to minimize transaction costs and maximize terminal wealth levels whilst adhering to strict portfolio turnover constraints.

arxiv-2407-13375.title: A Note on quasi-transitive graphs quasi-isometric to planar (Cayley) graphs
arxiv-2407-13375.creator: Joseph Paul MacManus
arxiv-2407-13375.description: Abstract . Given a connected, locally finite, quasi-transitive graph X X which is quasi-isometric to a planar graph Γ \Gamma , we remark that one can upgrade Γ \Gamma to be a planar Cayley graph, answering a question raised by Esperet–Giocanti and Hamann.

arxiv-2409-07552.description: Abstract We present a JWST NIRSpec transmission spectrum of the super-Earth exoplanet L 98-59 c. This small (R p = 1.385 ± 0.085 {}_{p}=1.385\pm 0.085 R ⊕ , M p = 2.22 ± 0.26 {}_{p}=2.22\pm 0.26 R ⊕ ), warm (T eq = 553 {}_{\textrm{eq}}=553 K) planet resides in a multi-planet system around a nearby, bright (J = 7.

arxiv-2501-01708.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Akanksha ID , Anuj Kumar Bhagat ID , and Ritumoni Sarma ID. In this article, for a finite field 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} and a natural number l , l, let ℛ \mathcal{R} denote the product ring 𝔽 q l .

arxiv-2501-18579.title: Near-Field SAR Imaging of Moving Targets on Roads
arxiv-2501-18579.creator: Raz Rajwan, Amir Boag, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2501-18579.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Raz Rajwan, Amir Boag, Fellow, IEEE. This paper introduces a single-channel SAR algorithm designed to detect and produce high-fidelity images of moving targets in spotlight mode. The proposed fast backprojection algorithm utilizes multi-level interpolations and aggregation of coarse images produced from partial datasets. Specifically designed for near-field scenarios and assuming a circular radar trajectory, the algorithm demonstrates enhanced efficiency in detecting both moving and stationary vehicles on roads.

arxiv-2511-04977.title: GSE: Evaluating Sticker Visual Semantic Similarity via a General Sticker Encoder
arxiv-2511-04977.creator: Heng Er Metilda Chee, Jiayin Wang, Zhiqiang Guo, Weizhi Ma, Min Zhang
arxiv-2511-04977.description: Abstract Stickers have become a popular form of visual communication, yet understanding their semantic relationships remains challenging due to their highly diverse and symbolic content. In this work, we formally define the Sticker Semantic Similarity task and introduce Triple-S , the first benchmark for this task, consisting of 905 human-annotated positive and negative sticker pairs.

arxiv-2604-00150.title: Data-Driven Reachability of Nonlinear Lipschitz Systems via Koopman Operator Embeddings
arxiv-2604-00150.creator: Alireza Naderi Akhormeh, Ahmad Hafez, Abdulla Fawzy, Amr Alanwar

arxiv-2605-07284.title: Instruction Tuning Changes How Upstream State Conditions Late Readout: A Cross-Patching Diagnostic
arxiv-2605-07284.creator: Yifan Zhou

pmc-10523088.title: Angular reproduction numbers improve estimates of transmissibility when disease generation times are misspecified or time-varying
pmc-10523088.creator: Kris V Parag, Benjamin J Cowling, Ben C Lambert
pmc-10523088.description: We introduce the angular reproduction number Ω, which measures time-varying changes in epidemic transmissibility resulting from variations in both the effective reproduction number R, and generation time distribution w. Predominant approaches for tracking pathogen spread infer either R or the epidemic growth rate r.

pmc-10606534.title: Influence of Hydrothermal Treatment of Brewer’s Spent Grain on the Concentration and Molecular Weight Distribution of 1,3-1,4-β-D-Glucan and Arabinoxylan
pmc-10606534.creator: Julia Steiner, Michael Kupetz, Thomas Becker
pmc-10606534.description: Brewer’s spent grain (BSG) is the most abundant residual in the brewing process. Non-starch polysaccharides such as 1,3-1,4-β-D-glucan (β-glucan) and arabinoxylan (AX) with proven beneficial effects on human health remain in this by-product in high amounts. Incorporating the valuable dietary fiber into the food industry could contribute to a healthy diet.

pmc-10738833.title: ASSOCIATIONS BETWEEN DAILY STRESSORS AND ALCOHOL USE IN THE MIDUS STUDY
pmc-10738833.creator: Sara Miller, David Almeida
pmc-10738833.description: Daily stressors are minor but frequent challenges of everyday life (e.g., arguments). Although daily stressors are typically less severe than stressful life events, daily stressors can have more immediate effects on wellbeing. Despite this relevance, there is limited research evaluating the influence of daily stressors on alcohol use in older populations.

pmc-11457377.title: Relationships between screen time and childhood attention deficit hyperactivity disorder: a Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11457377.creator: Zhuo Meng, Bo Ao, Wei Wang, Tongtong Niu, Yanan Chen, Xiaoqing Ma, Youliang Huang
pmc-11457377.description: BackgroundIn previous observational studies and meta-analyses, childhood attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is found to have a significant association with screen time. However, the causal associations between them remain unclear.MethodThis study performed a bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis to confirm the causality between screen time and childhood ADHD.

pmc-11470200.title: Preferences of patients and physicians in the United States for relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma treatments
pmc-11470200.creator: Caitlin Thomas, Kevin Marsh, Myrto Trapali, Nicolas Krucien, Gavin Worth, Paul Cockrum, Debra Lycett
pmc-11470200.description: BackgroundPatients with follicular lymphoma (FL) often relapse or become refractory to treatment (R/R). While the R/R FL treatment landscape evolves, little is known about the priorities of patients and physicians. This discrete‐choice experiment (DCE) study assessed patients' and physicians' treatment preferences, and the trade‐offs they would be willing to make between efficacy, tolerability, and administration.

pmc-11520857.title: High-throughput phenotyping in maize and soybean genotypes using vegetation indices and computational intelligence
pmc-11520857.creator: Paulo E. Teodoro, Larissa P. R. Teodoro, Fabio H. R. Baio, Carlos A. Silva Junior, Dthenifer C. Santana, Leonardo L. Bhering
pmc-11520857.description: Building models that allow phenotypic evaluation of complex agronomic traits in crops of global economic interest, such as grain yield (GY) in soybean and maize, is essential for improving the efficiency of breeding programs. In this sense, understanding the relationships between agronomic variables and those obtained by high-throughput phenotyping (HTP) is crucial to this goal.

pmc-12641656.title: Influence of Neonatal Exposure to Hyperoxia on Skeletal Muscle in a Rat Model
pmc-12641656.creator: Kentaro Awata, Irena Santosa, Yoshiteru Arai, Mayu Nakagawa, Hiroki Suganuma, Hiromichi Shoji
pmc-12641656.description: Background/Objectives: Premature births below 32 weeks of gestation generally require respiratory oxygen support, leading to a relatively hyperoxic environment compared to in utero conditions. Transient hyperoxia exposure has been linked to an elevated risk of chronic lung disease and retinopathy of prematurity; however, its effects on skeletal muscles remain elusive.

pmc-12656793.title: Novel Recombinase Polymerase Amplification Assay Is Sensitive for Detection of Macrolide Resistance Genes Relevant to Bovine Respiratory Disease Management in Feedlot Calves
pmc-12656793.creator: Tara Funk, Lianne McLeod, Cheyenne C Conrad, Rahat Zaheer, Simon J G Otto, Cheryl L Waldner, Tim A McAllister, Fabrizio Bertelloni, Francesca Ciotola
pmc-12656793.description: Simple SummaryBovine respiratory disease (BRD) is a major health concern in feedlot cattle, and macrolide antibiotics are commonly used to treat it. However, the rise in antimicrobial resistance threatens their effectiveness, making it crucial for veterinarians to have fast and accurate tools to guide treatment decisions.

pmc-12691886.title: A Multidimensional Definition of Pre-Osteoarthritis: Toward 21st-Century Subclinical Detection and Targeted Intervention
pmc-12691886.creator: Eloy del Río, Jung Eun Kim
pmc-12691886.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Osteoarthritis (OA) is a leading cause of pain, disability, and healthcare utilization worldwide, yet clinical diagnosis commonly occurs after irreversible structural damage, limiting opportunities for prevention. Advances in molecular profiling, quantitative imaging, biomechanics, and longitudinal cohort studies have identified a reproducible preclinical interval, termed pre-osteoarthritis (pre-OA), during which molecular, compositional, and biomechanical perturbations emerge long before persistent symptoms or radiographic changes. The recognition of pre-OA as a distinct pathophysiologically meaningful stage supports the possibility of earlier targeted interception.

pmc-12784674.title: Identification and Expression Analysis of the CHX Gene Family in Capsicum annuum L.
pmc-12784674.creator: Jing Wang, Jiaxin Huang, Xu Jia, Yanping Liang
pmc-12784674.description: Simple SummaryPepper is an important vegetable crop, but its growth is often threatened by environmental stresses such as high soil salinity, which affects yield and quality. This study comprehensively identifies and analyzes the cation/H+ exchanger (CHX) gene family in pepper, which helps plants to maintain internal chemical balance under stress.

pmc-13254783.title: Inflammation, fronto-amygdala connectivity, and negative affective reactivity to daily stress in adolescents
pmc-13254783.creator: Eugenia Giampetruzzi, Justin P Yuan, Jessica P Uy, Chase Antonacci, Yoonji Lee, Ian H Gotlib
pmc-13254783.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMaladaptive affective responses to daily stress in adolescence are a robust risk factor for the development of psychopathology. Importantly, however, adolescents vary widely in the magnitude of their affective reactivity to stress.

pmc-13596973.title: The Association Between Hispanic Ethnicity, Cholecystectomy, and Postoperative Mortality
pmc-13596973.creator: Priyanka Singh, Noah Z. Freundlich, Gezzer Ortega, Robert Parody, Mayur Narayan, Joseph Hanna, Brian L. Strom, Gregory L. Peck
pmc-13596973.description: Introduction:Hispanic ethnicity is associated with an increased incidence of gallstone disease. Emergency cholecystectomy has a higher case fatality rate than nonemergency cholecystectomy, yet it remains common. We aimed to determine whether an association exists between Hispanic ethnicity, cholecystectomy type, and mortality.Methods:The National Surgical Quality Improvement Program database was queried for cholecystectomy cases from 2005 to 2019. Cases included cholecystectomy type.
